# EduLift

Free interactive 3D simulators for learning science and engineering. Explore a 3D circulatory system and a power transformer, part by part.

## Home

- https://edu-lift-omega.vercel.app/ : EduLift — Interactive 3D Simulators

## Simulators

- https://edu-lift-omega.vercel.app/simulators/heart-lab/ : Heart Lab — 3D Circulatory System Simulator
- https://edu-lift-omega.vercel.app/simulators/transformer-lab/ : Transformer Lab — 3D Power Transformer Simulator
